lore: Fragments of saves wash up on DiskSaver Island every tide, snagging on the saves already there and on each other, tangling into knots. Storms snap the threads, and whole knots drift loose where no island can reach them. The gulls clear the drift: they fly every thread from the islands to mark what is still held, then strip the beach of everything unmarked. Call them every tide and they never rest; never call them and the beach drowns in drift.

lines.start: Twelve hundred saves on the islands and the tide's bringing more. My gulls fly when you call them.
lines.storm: Threads snapped all down the strand. Some of that drift is knotted to itself now.
lines.sweep: Gulls up! Mark everything an island still holds, then clear the rest.
lines.win: The beach never drowned, my gulls never dropped from the sky, and not one held save was taken.
lines.fail: Either the drift buried the beach or my gulls are worn to feathers. Call them on a better tide.
